title: Recently opened item shortcuts
whyItMatters: .lnk shortcuts in the Recent folder list files and folders the user opened, including names from drives now removed.
source: SANS Windows forensic poster: %APPDATA%/Microsoft/Windows/Recent (.lnk shortcut files)
notes: Counts shortcut files only, not the AutomaticDestinations and CustomDestinations jump-list folders, which have their own rule. One trace per folder (count, size, 3 sample names) instead of one per file, so the report does not list every recently opened file name.

steps: Open File Explorer, select See more (the three dots) and then Options.
In the Privacy section select Clear; this empties the recent items for this account.
Delete any shortcut files still in the folder named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Clears the list of recently opened items for this account. New shortcuts appear as files are opened again.
